name: Hyperpop PM
description: Physical-modeling percussion voice that morphs from tight hats and glitch clicks to jungly snare textures

knobs.1: Morph (tight closed hat -> glitch click -> jungly snare)

switches.1: Morph bias (up=hat bias, center=full macro range, down=snare bias)
switches.2: Gate behavior (up=G1 main + G2 accent, center=G2 choke, down=dual trigger layer)

gate_in.1: Main trigger (patch from RS-9 closed hat/rim for core pulse train)
gate_in.2: Accent/open trigger (patch from RS-9 open hat/snare accent lane)

leds: K1..K6 parameter intensity meters, LED7 trigger pulse, LED8 accent activity
audio_in: Used as exciter source when present (mono detect from L/R); automatically falls back to internal noise exciter when silent, and is also lightly summed for layering
